title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕
Wednesday, September 9, 2026

🌤️ Weather — Cloudy, breezy, high near 80°F, low upper 60s. Showers and a possible thunderstorm building by evening, with patchy fog overnight. Grab an umbrella and a light layer for the ride home.

🗞️ Headlines
- Trump asks the Supreme Court to restore states' access to the SAVE voter database.
- Mayor Mamdani releases ~170,000 documents suggesting New Yorkers were misled about post-9/11 air quality.
- Federal judge temporarily blocks a NYC law targeting Uber and Lyft.
- Democrats grapple with their socialist upstarts as attention turns past the midterms.
- Survey: identity theft, online theft, and home burglary top Americans' crime worries.

🚇 Getting around — Nothing major systemwide today. Heads-up for later this week: the G suspends between Court Sq and Bedford–Nostrand, Fri 9:45p → Mon 5a (shuttle buses running).

🎉 NYC today — Yankees host a home game (7:05p). On Broadway, The Lion King at the Minskoff (7p); MJ matinee at 1p. LUCKI plays Brooklyn Paramount (7p). NYC Fashion Week parties in full swing.

💡 Nugget — Tomorrow is 9/11 remembrance — the FDNY holds a citywide, family-friendly open house on Sept 10 if you want to visit a firehouse and thank a crew.

Sources: AccuWeather, WAMC, Mueller She Wrote, MTA, Time Out NY
